data.name: Voxenvale
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Voxenvale, a cozy online world where players build, jump, explore, and hang out in small cubic realms.

Create your account, enter the lobby, search for realms, and start shaping your own space with detailed cartoon-style blocks. Place grass, dirt, stone, and cobblestone, visit other players, chat above your character, and move around with playful third-person controls like double jumping and slam landing.

Voxenvale is in early development. The current version focuses on the core online loop: login, lobby, realm travel, block placement, mining, inventory, and shared player presence.

Features:

- Online lobby and player realms

- Block placement, mining, and inventory

- Detailed cartoon-style voxel textures

- Third-person movement with double jump and slam

- Player name tags, flags, and chat bubbles

- Server-saved accounts, realms, inventory, and blocks

An internet connection and Voxenvale account are required to play.
